I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message. I said I'd noted they'll be on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile. I also offered to tell other people or block the morning on their calendar.

The calendar search for Oct 15 came back empty, and I told Hollis there was nothing to clash with. That may not cover everything: the tool lists events for whoever it's acting for, and it may have checked my calendar instead of Hollis's. Hollis didn't ask for anything else, so I didn't take any other action.
